note: Fields exist only via this registry (CAS 4.1). Records must not contain fields absent from the registry as of their declared schema_version; consumers must ignore fields added after their own version. Fields are deprecated, never removed. Vocabulary values are added through governance, never invented inline.

id.purpose: Permanent unique name; never reused or renamed (CAS 9.5)

schema_version.purpose: Binds the record to the registry version defining its meaning

corpus_version.purpose: Release the record was authored against

split.purpose: dev|test|hidden; assigned only at Stage 8 by a release manager

text.purpose: The sample, byte-exact; never normalized in storage (BS 5.2)

track.purpose: Track letter; must agree with the category

length_words.purpose: Exact count by the harness counter, not contributor-supplied (CAS 4.2)

length_bucket.purpose: B25..B1000; bucket membership is ground truth (BS 2.5)

label.purpose: Authorship process; derived mechanically from evidence, never chosen (CAS 4.2)

ai_token_share.purpose: Fraction of final tokens of model origin; computed from stored diff chains, hand-entered values are non-conformant (CAS 4.2)

span_map.purpose: Region-level origin; must tile the text without overlap; created at production time (CAS 3.5, 4.2)

provenance_tier.purpose: T0-T3; tier expresses evidence strength, not text quality (CAS 5.1)

provenance_ref.purpose: Pointer to the retained evidence package; must resolve, checksums must verify

generator.purpose: Full production configuration; REQUIRED whenever label is not HUMAN, MUST be absent when label is HUMAN — presence with HUMAN is a P2 alarm (CAS 4.2)
generator.notes: CANONICAL (ratified 2026-08-05): required for EVERY non-HUMAN label (AI, AI_HUMAN_EDITED, HUMAN_AI_EDITED, COLLAB_MIXED); MUST be absent for HUMAN. Only pure HUMAN is exempt.

transforms.purpose: Ordered transform records with method identity, version/date, parameters; each regenerable or exactly verifiable (CAS 4.2)

topic_group_id.purpose: Matched-topic set link so content and process effects separate (BS 2.8)

difficulty.purpose: D1-D5; provisional at candidacy, empirical after first release, never hand-edited (CAS 7)

rationale.purpose: 1-3 sentences: why this sample belongs to its class and cell; non-boilerplate

target_weakness.purpose: The detector assumption probed, mapped to the failure-mode registry (BS 6)

expected_confusions.purpose: DF codes expected to err; optional but recommended
expected_confusions.notes: CANONICAL (ratified 2026-08-05): OPTIONAL. CAS 4.2 governs over BS 4.7/5.2. Do not reopen without a CAS 14.3 amendment.

noisy_label.purpose: True only for T3 DEV material (CAS 5.2)

license.purpose: Legal basis for inclusion and redistribution; 'unknown' is not a value (CAS 4.2)

pii_status.purpose: clean|scrubbed|synthetic; scrubbed requires the scrubbing record in evidence

notes.purpose: Free text; never load-bearing; nothing normative may live only in notes (CAS 4.2)

lineage.purpose: Declared relationships to other identifiers (P10); every intentional relationship is declared, undeclared similarity is a defect

difficulty_panel_version.purpose: Reference panel version that produced the empirical difficulty; null while provisional (CAS 7.2-7.3)

difficulty_provisional.purpose: True while difficulty derives from structural facts only, before first-release panel evaluation (CAS 7.3)

relationship_types.derived_from: This sample was produced by transforming the target (CAS 3.6, 8.2)
relationship_types.supersedes: This candidate replaces a rejected/frozen predecessor (CAS 2 Stage 2, 6.5)

history.change: CAS adoption: lineage, difficulty panel binding fields; relationship-type, role vocabularies. Additive only; v1 records remain valid under v1.
Ratified canonical interpretations TD-A01 (expected_confusions optional), TD-A02 (generator required for all non-HUMAN), TD-A03 (version-specific validation). No schema change.

interpretations.ruling: required for all non-HUMAN labels; absent for HUMAN
schema requirements are version-specific; newer fields never retroactively invalidate older records
